source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Dismissing these particular concerns as unimportant when compared with the client's overall physical health status and more immediate medical needs","B":"Assuming that every client experiences essentially identical feelings about depending on supplemental oxygen equipment from one day to the next","C":"Acknowledging the genuine impact on body image and social participation, and connecting the client with resources to support continued engagement in valued activities","D":"Discouraging the client from taking part in social activities altogether, in order to help keep the oxygen equipment less visible to others around them"}}
source_row.rationale: Supporting a client's adjustment to oxygen dependence includes acknowledging the genuine impact on body image and social participation, and connecting the client with resources or strategies (such as portable equipment options or peer support) to support continued engagement in valued activities, rather than assuming identical experiences or discouraging social participation.
